source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Ουρσίκιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole notice is one paragraph: he lived in the years of the king Maximian, «(286 - 305 μ.Χ.)» as the page dates that reign, and came of the city Σιβεντού of Upper Illyria; he was a soldier and had reached the rank of tribune; he was denounced to Maximian by a certain Ualens as a Christian and referred to the eparch Aristeides for examination; he confessed with courage, was tortured hard and in many ways, and because he persisted in confessing Christ was beheaded. The corpus keeps no other saint of this name. The `soldier` type is the page's own «ήταν στρατιωτικός»; his tribune's rank is in the display name and no `office` is recorded for it, there being no locale pack entry for a Roman military rank. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no apolytikion and no kontakion, so this folder takes no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Ουρσίκιος έζησε στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Μαξιμιανού (286 - 305 μ.Χ.)». The page gives no year of its own for his death; the interval is the reign it prints, within which the notice places both his life and his beheading.
